posting.title: Partnership Development Manager UK&I - Payroll & Accounting Ecosystem (Barcelona based)
posting.description:
Hello! 👋🏻



At Factorial, we believe our growth is powered by the strength of our partner ecosystem. As we continue to scale globally, we’re looking for a Partnerships Development Manager for the UK&I 
(Payroll & Accounting Ecosystem focus)
 to help expand, strengthen, and accelerate our partner network.



You’ll play a pivotal, strategic role in driving Factorial’s growth by taking full ownership of building and scaling our partner ecosystem - spanning channel sales, reseller networks, and strategic alliances, with a strong focus on the Payroll & Accounting Ecosystem. You will directly shape and lead our network of local partners, accountants, bookkeepers, and software resellers who sell, implement, and support our AI for business solution.




Ready to be part of the challenge? 🚀





What you'll do 


📝





Search for & map new potential partners in the HR, Payroll, and Accounting space with a strong footprint in the Accounting & Payroll Ecosystem, executing the full partner recruitment and sales cycle with them.



Leverage accounting firm networks, payroll bureaus, and reseller channels to drive strategic distribution and partner growth across the UK&I market.



Act as the main point of contact for key Accounting & Payroll-focused partners, VARs (Value-Added Resellers), and advisory consultancies.



Hold regular meetings (calls, video meetings, demos) with your partners and their clients, keeping them updated on the product, integrations (e.g., automated journal syncs, payroll exports), and finding solutions to specific problems they may have.



Gather feedback from partners and clients to identify pain points, software integration opportunities, and ways to further mature our partnership channel.



Upsell any additional Factorial products/services to partners based on client needs.



Collaborate daily with internal teams, from SDRs, Product, Marketing, Customer Experience and Senior Leadership.



Play a key role alongside founding team members to drive UK&I market share, traveling to the UK&I frequently for industry events, accounting tech meetups, and key partner visits.






What are we looking for? 


🎯





Hunter mentality, hungry, persistent and ready to hustle.



Have 3–4 years of experience in Partnerships or Channel Sales, preferably in a SaaS company or digital transformation environment.



Required experience working with or within key UK&I Payroll & Accounting vendors (such as Sage, Xero, BrightPay, or IRIS).



Understanding of accounting firm dynamics, payroll bureau operations, and vendor partner playbooks.



Experience working with and within the UK market.



You have knowledge or experience in Human Resources / Software / Payroll & Accounting.



Are a strong communicator and quickly build trust with people.



Are proactive and enjoy bringing forward new ideas.



Are an English expert speaker. Other languages are a plus!



Are based in Barcelona (or willing to relocate).





Bonus Points ⭐



Direct experience working with specialized UK&I software distributors or accounting tech marketplaces.



Experience in full-cycle B2B sales.



Experience working with SMBs and accountancy practices.






Perks of being part of Factorial 😎




Competitive ESOP plan 
📈




High growth, multicultural and friendly environment 🤝

About Factorial 🚀


Founded in Barcelona in 2016, we are 
one of the most exciting tech players in Europe
—backed by top investors, including our recent 
$150M Series D with General Catalyst
. We now have +1,700 employees serving more than 
20,000 companies
 across 112 countries.



Factorial started with a simple idea: companies were spending too much time managing processes and not enough time doing the work they were hired to do: their best work.

But as companies grow, work gets more disconnected. More people, more tools, more information, and more time spent connecting the dots. Generic AI can answer questions, but it doesn’t know your company. Every time, you have to give it the context.



Factorial is different. Because it’s inside the company, it already knows how it works, including its people, processes, policies, and data. So you can ask it to do real work, from screening candidates and managing expenses to answering questions and creating reports.



AI isn’t the goal. Giving people back their time is.

Factorial is the AI for Business that knows companies, connects how work happens across the business, and turns that context into action.


When work changes, so do we.





We believe in diverse talent: 
we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and strongly encourage people of diverse experiences and identities to apply.


We believe in inclusion:
 we are committed to equal opportunities and actively promote workplace inclusion of people with disabilities. If you would like to learn more about our inclusive recruitment processes, you are welcome to indicate so optionally and we will share additional information with you.




Our Values 🫀





We own it:
 We take responsibility for every project. We make decisions, not excuses.




We learn and teach:
 We're dedicated to learning something new every day and, above all, share it.




We partner:
 Every decision is a team decision. We trust each other.




We grow fast:
 We act fast. We think that the worst mistake is not learning from them.





Wanna learn more about us? Check our website!

posting.title: SDR Outbound
posting.description:
Hello! 👋

At Factorial we're looking for a new 
Outbound
 
Sales Development Representative
 for the 
Mexico Market
 to help us support and scale our 
Sales
 team to the next level. As part of the team in charge of 
creating new business opportunities and driving pipeline growth
, you'll be in charge of 
prospecting potential customers, qualifying opportunities, and partnering with Account Executives to accelerate revenue growth.





Ready to be part of the challenge?
 🚀

We believe in developing our people, sharing our culture, and spreading our vision of how Human Resources can make a real impact on organizations around the world.




About the team 👥


Our Partners team is on a mission to connect businesses with the HR solutions they need to grow — and we’re just getting started. If you love the thrill of building real relationships and want to be part of a team that’s shaping the future of HR, this is your place.




What you'll do 📝





Identify and prospect potential customers through cold calls, email outreach, LinkedIn, and other channels.




Qualify inbound and outbound leads to generate high-quality sales opportunities.




Conduct discovery conversations to understand customer challenges and business needs.




Schedule meetings between qualified prospects and Account Executives.




Research target accounts and develop personalized outreach strategies.




Collaborate with Account Executives to ensure a smooth and effective sales process.




Partner with Marketing, Customer Experience, and Product teams to improve prospect engagement.




Track activities, pipeline progress, and prospect information using CRM tools.





Experiment with new prospecting approaches and continuously improve conversion rates.









What are we looking for? 🎯





1+ year of experience in sales, business development, lead generation, or customer-facing roles.




Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.




Confidence engaging with prospects through cold outreach.




Self-motivated, proactive, and goal-oriented mindset.




Strong organizational and time management skills.




Curiosity and willingness to learn in a fast-paced environment.




Team-player attitude with a collaborative approach to problem-solving.




Ability to take ownership of results and continuously improve performance.




Passion for technology, SaaS, and business growth.




Intermediate to advanced English proficiency.





Factorial bets for potential and growth. We currently evaluate all seniority levels, as we believe diversity and collaboration are the key for rocking the world! If you seek a place to demonstrate ownership of your own success, but you don't meet every point of this Job Description, please, apply anyway!




Benefits 🎉



Perks of Being Part of Our Team!





High-growth, multicultural, and friendly environment.




Language exchange opportunities at Factorial.




Free coffee and tea ☕️




Private health insurance, nutrition, and therapy support.




Wellhub (Gympass) 🧘🏻‍♀️




Hybrid work model and shorter Fridays.




Breakfast and snacks 🥞🍒







About Factorial 🚀


Factorial is an all-in-one HR software company founded in 2016 and one of the fastest-growing companies in the HR tech space. Our mission is to help small and medium-sized businesses automate HR workflows, centralize employee data, and make better business decisions.

Today, we serve thousands of customers in more than 60 countries across multiple industries. We’ve built a diverse and multicultural team of over 900 people across our offices in Barcelona, Brazil, Mexico, and the United States. 🌎🌎




Our Values🫀






We own it
: We take responsibility for every project. We make decisions, not excuses.





We learn and teach
: We are committed to learning something new every day and, most importantly, sharing that knowledge with others.





We partner
: Every decision is a team decision. We trust one another.





We grow fast
: We move quickly. We believe the biggest mistake is failing to learn from our mistakes.

posting.title: Strategic Partner Business Developer DACH Market
posting.description:
Hello! 👋🏽


At Factorial, we’re looking for a 
Strategic Partner Business Developer for the DACH market 
to help us elevate our partner ecosystem and drive growth by activating strategic partners, enabling their sales teams, and turning partner relationships into a consistent source of qualified pipeline and demos.

This is your chance to shape Factorial’s partner strategy in a fast-growing environment.

Are you ready to be part of the challenge? 🚀




About the team 


👥



Our Partners team opens doors to new markets by building meaningful partnerships that help us grow together. If you thrive on collaboration and love creating win-win relationships, we’d love to have you on board.




What you'll do 


📝



As a 
Strategic Partner Business Developer
, your mission is taking ownership of partner activation, engagement and commercial performance within your assigned region.




Partner & Sales Enablement




Serve as the central point of contact and proactive advisor for partner sales teams and their leadership.



Strengthen partner relationships through regular communication and strategic engagement rom individual sales representatives to regional leadership.



Activate partner sales teams through initial enablement sessions, ongoing engagement and targeted commercial activities, moving teams to consistent partner-driven pipeline generation.



Design and deliver sales enablement training to equip sales teams with partner knowledge and strategies (i.e. through workshops).






Pipeline & Opportunity Management




Define and execute pipeline generation strategies to maximize partner-driven leads.



Work closely with partner Account Managers and sales leaders to identify opportunities, remove blockers and define concrete actions to increase partner engagement and pipeline generation.



Qualify partner-generated leads and opportunities, understand the prospect's business needs, and ensure a smooth handover to the Partner Account Executive.






Lead Generation & Engagement




Collaborate closely with Partner Account Executives, Marketing, CX teams, and Partner Sales Management to ensure alignment and plan demand generation activities.



Engage prospects through (cold) calls, emails, social outreach, campaigns, networking and events.



Coordinate and schedule demos with prospects and partners.



Reactivate stalled deals and ensure a clean, active, and predictable pipeline.






What are we looking for? 


🎯





High fluency/native-level 
German

 English
.



Previous experience in Sales (Customer Success, Project Management, Partnerships, or similar roles) are highly valued.



Tech-savvy with a strong passion for digital innovation.



Comfortable picking up the phone and engaging with prospects and partner stakeholders.



Detail-oriented, accountable, creative, team-oriented, open-minded, self-motivated, and ambitious to grow in a fast-scaling team.



You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next.



Excited to actively contribute to constant improvement and evolution—we embrace a strong culture of change!



Reiselust: Partnerships are built through personal connections: regular on-site visits, sales team activations and partner events are an essential part of the role.






Bonus Points




Experience with tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Excel, Notion, Lovable etc.



Background in Partnerships or Sales within a SaaS or digital environment.



Solid understanding of how to build and execute successful outbound campaigns.






What do we offer?




Join one of the fastest-scaling, most strategic teams at Factorial (2.5x YoY growth).



Take real ownership of strategic partner relationships and become the go-to commercial partner for sales teams and leadership. Build relationships that directly fuel Factorial’s growth across key markets.



Work in a fast-paced, ambitious environment where every interaction counts.
